entries.comment: RD N° 20, Table A, category XXI; For CN codes 9701 90 00, 9706 00 00 and 4911 91 00: excl. utensils and for CN code (9706 00 00): excl. articles composed of dried or preserved plants, animals or parts thereof, presented in such a way (e.g. in blocks of plastic, behind glass or between two sheets of glass stuck together) that because of their decorative appearance they are intended to decorate houses -stuffed animals and parts of stuffed animals made in large quantities from the same species
